items.question: The heart is one of the ______ parts of our body.
This is ______ useful fact about our blood.
White cells are ______ than red cells in size.
This drop of blood is as ______ as that one.
Doing daily exercise is ______ for everyone.
This is ______ liquid I have ever seen.

exam_exercises.text: Part 2 — Fill in the Blanks (۱۵ نمره)

exam_exercises.instruction: Fill in the blanks with the correct form of the adjective (healthy, important, dangerous, useful, big).

items.text: Eating fresh food is ______ (healthy) than eating junk food.
Blood is one of the ______ (important) liquids in our body.
White blood cells are ______ (big) than red blood cells.
This is the ______ (useful) fact I have learned about the human body.

exam_exercises.instruction: Choose the correct word: as or than.

items.text: Red cells are not as big ______ white cells.
This drop of blood is as small ______ that one.
The heart works harder ______ other body parts during exercise.
Our body is as amazing ______ any machine in the world.

items.answer: Plasma is clearer than blood cells.
items.text: Plasma is a clear liquid. Blood cells are a thick liquid. (plasma / clear)

items.answer: The heart is the most important organ of all.
items.text: The heart is an important organ. (of all the organs)

items.answer: A tiger is as dangerous as a lion.
items.text: A tiger is dangerous. A lion is dangerous, too.
